Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka will be disappointed. That is an understatement. After surviving the opening hour, the batsmen simply threw it away and then the rest were not patient enough. Dickwella played some shots but that only lent some respectability to the total. The night session will provide plenty of movement, so the Lankan quicks will be hoping to get 4-5 wickets before Stumps. Stay tuned...

It was a total team effort from the Aussie quicks. They struggled with their lengths in the first hour of the morning, going too full, searching for swing when there was none, but then they hit their straps by adjusting well. Towards the end of the second session, they found some swing which was helpful, especially for Starc, who is going through a torrid period.

Just 6.4 overs needed for the Aussies after the Dinner break to dismantle the Lankan innings. A terrific bowling performance to say the least but what will please Australia is that the man guns - Starc, Cummins and Lyon did not have to do too much. Yes, Cummins did pick up 4 but the talk of the town will be the debutant Jhye Richardson, who rocked the middle order.

OUT! Chameera is the last man dismissed. Cummins gets his 4th of the innings. Once again shorter in length, Chameera tries to pull that one away but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air and to the fielder at gully. Kurtis Patterson there takes his second catch in the same over. Dushmantha Chameera's resilient innings comes to an end. Scored no runs but gave plenty of support to Dickwella in their 38-run stand. SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 144.
Bouncer. Dushmantha does well to duck underneath it.
Lahiru Kumara is the last batsman in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! Dickwella falls at last. The short delivery does the trick. Around middle and leg, Niroshan looks to pull but it gets big on him. It lobs towards deep mid-wicket where Kurtis Patterson takes a comfortable catch. Brilliant innings under pressure. Australia are just one wicket away from wrapping up the innings. Cummins gets his third.
Bowls a bouncer down leg, Dickwella does well to duck under it.
Tossed up on middle, Chameera keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chameera blocks it off his back foot.
Floated on off, Dushmantha defends off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Dickwella sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Niroshan comes down the track and hits it over covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Tossed up on middle, Dickwella plays a reverse sweep to point.

Yes he can. Beautiful delivery by Cummins to finish off the over. It is full outside off, the ball moves away just a bit after pitching. Chameera tries to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Bouncer! Chameera ducks underneath it. Can he survive the last ball?
Once again back off a length, Niroshan this time pulls it in a controlled manner towards fine leg for a single.
In the air but safe. Shorter on length, Dickwella pulls it. It hits high on his bat but has enough on it to go over the in-field. The ball falls in no mans land and Niroshan gets a couple from it.
Length delivery outside off, Niroshan tries to cut it but the ball goes over his bat.
FOUR! Handy runs for Sri Lanka. Bouncer by Cummins, Dickwella goes for the pull but gets a top edge. Luckily for him the ball goes wide of the fine leg fielder and into the fence for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Dushmantha defends off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Dushmantha defends off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on leg, the batsman flicks it to the leg side.
Floated on middle, Dushmantha flicks it to the leg side.
Tossed up on leg, Chameera pushes it to the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chameera defends off the back foot.
Short of a length delivery, the keeper-batsman cuts it to point.
Good length delivery outside off again, Dickwella looks to cut but gets beaten on this one.
Outside off, Niroshan makes room and looks to cut but misses it.
Short of a length delivery again, Dickwella pulls it over mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Short of a length delivery, Niroshan pulls it to square leg.
Length delivery on middle, Dickwella plays a paddle sweep to the leg side.
Ends the over by getting right behind the delivery and blocking it.
Tossed up off spinner on off, Chameera defends it off his front foot.
Shorter in length around off, Chameera does well to block that one.
Full on middle, Dickwella sweeps it away on the on side for a single.

FOUR! Fifty for Niroshan Dickwella. 11th Test fifty for him. First against Australia. Good shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Dickwella sweeps it through square leg. The fielder dives but in vain and it is a boundary. Great innings under pressure.
Tossed up on middle, Niroshan sweeps it to the leg side.
Nathan Lyon back on.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, the keeper-batsman looks to cut but gets beaten on this one.
FOUR! Good shot. Short outside off, Dickwella makes room and cuts it over point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Niroshan looks to cut but loses his balance in the process and misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Dickwella looks to pull but gets an inside edge to the leg side.
Outside off, Dickwella leaves it alone.
Welcome back for the last session. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Niroshan Dickwella and Dushmantha Chameera will resume their innings. Pat Cummins will start the proceedings.
... Day 1, Session 3 ...
Australia will want to echo what Marcus Harris said and will wrap this up quickly. They will enjoy their supper for now. Join us after the break.

Neroli Meadows is having a chat with Marcus Harris. The southpaw is happy with the way things are going. States that the Australian team had discussed in the dressing room to bowl in the right areas and hope that they finish off the job after the break. On Jhye Richardson, he admits that Jhye was a bit nervous but with time those nerves settled down. On batting under lights, Marcus is not too perturbed and is eager to strut his stuff when the chance comes.

Starc has been better in his last spell. Got the ball in the right areas and earned his 200th Test wicket. The skipper will hope he cleans up the tail. Richardson has been marvelous. Ran through the middle order with Cummins and it won't be long before the hosts come out to bat.

Australia's session. By far. After taking three wickets in the first one they have come out and taken 5 in this period. Bowled at the right lengths and kept beating the outside edges of the Lankan players. Just a couple of batsmen got to the double figures and that speaks volumes. Dickwella is still out there and the Asian side will hope he adds as many runs as possible to give the bowlers something to bowl at.
Good length delivery outside off, Chameera looks to defend but gets beaten on this one. Big over for Sri Lanka. THAT IS DINNER ON DAY 1.
What a delivery by Starc. Bowls a yorker on middle, Dickwella manages to dig it out and gets an inside edge. It goes towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Niroshan plays it to point.
SIX! Fine improvisation from Niroshan Dickwella. Length delivery on middle, Dickwella gets on one knee and scoops it over Tim Paine for a biggie.
Full outside off, Dickwella makes room and plays it uppishly wide of point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! Amazing shot. Full on off, Dickwella makes room to the leg side and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Chameera survives. Back of a length ball outside off, Chameera sways away from it.
Tries the similar shot again. This time connects but almost gives it to the man at short mid-wicket. Pulls it away from him and takes the run.
Length outside off, Dickwella tries to pull it fine but fails.
On middle and leg, ND plays it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Length ball aimed on middle, Niroshan gives himself room but blocks it from hitting the stumps.
Dickwella trying to be cheeky. Gets into position early and tries to scoop this over the keeper but fails.

NOT OUT. Nothing on the Hawk Eye. Nothing on Snicko. My ears are ringing. Full and outside off, Chameera looked to defend but the ball whizzed past the outside edge. Paine was not all that confident but Starc pretty much was. However, umpire Erasmus was unmoved. The skipper went for the review as the slip cordon heard a noise(nice...at least someone else heard the noise apart from me) but to their dismay, technology did not assist them.
Australia have taken a review for caught behind. Paine and co. think Chameera has edged it. Let's find out.

Another edge but lucky this time. On a good length around off, Chameera looks to defend but is squared up by the late movement. An outside edge is induced but this time the ball does not carry to gully. Good diving stop too.
Dushmantha Chameera is in at no. 10.

OUT! Dilruwan Perera departs as well! Sri Lanka are folding up now. Starc has his tail up and is wrapping the Lankan one now. Wonderful delivery. On a fuller length outside off, Perera looks to drive but there is some late outswing. Hence, he gets a thick outside edge towards third slip where Marnus Labuschagne takes another one. His third.
Back of a length ball aimed into the body of Dickwella who tucks it away on the leg side and changes ends.
Length ball outside off, another soft edge towards the point region.
Fuller ball outside off, Dickwella gets a bottom edge which falls short of the slip cordon.
Outside off, Perera lets it go. Just three runs off the over.
On off, Perera defends off the front foot.
On off, Perera taps it to point.
Good length delivery on off, Dilruwan defends off the back foot.
Full on off, Niroshan drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and dives to stop before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Outside off, Dickwella leaves it alone.
Jhye Richardson is back. 12-5-20-3 so far.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery on off, Perera defends off the back foot.
Interesting. Dilruwan Perera returns to bat.

OUT! Suranga Lakmal departs! Mitchell Starc gets his first wicket. 200th wicket for him. Good delivery from Starc. Full on off, Lakmal looks to defend but the ball moves away late. The batsman gets an outside edge towards third slip where Marnus Labuschagne takes a very good catch inches above the ground. Sri Lanka are seven down.
FOUR! 100 up for Sri Lanka. Good cricketing shot. Short outside off, Lakmal cuts it through point for a boundary.
Bowls it down the leg side, Lakmal looks to flick but misses it.
On the pads, Dickwella flicks it to deep square leg. All fielders on the boundary now as they expect him to go big. He takes one to give Lakmal the strike.
At 139.5 on middle stump, Dickwella turns it towards mid-wicket to retain the strike for the next over.
Outside off, Dickwella leaves it alone.
On the pads, Lakmal flicks it through mid-wicket and gets three runs for it. Quick hands from him.
Suranga Lakmal is forced to come in now, replacing Perera.

This is not good news. DILRUWAN IS WALKING OFF, RETIRED HURT. The way he was feeling while holding his bat, didn't seem like he would wish to bat. Sri Lanka would be more worried with his bowling prospects. He is a key bowler for them.

OUCH! Right on the thumb! Oh dear... Dilruwan is in too much pain. His bat has been thrown on the ground and he himself now is on his haunches. What a nasty blow from Cummins. He bowls a quick delivery, short in length, right on middle and leg. Perera looks to defend but the ball kicks off the surface and hits him hard on the thumb due to the pace of the delivery. It was bowled at 140.9 kph. It is also his bowling arm. The ball lobs off the glove and Marcus Harris at short leg tries to go for the catch but cannot get there.

Dilruwan is by no means comfortable. It is his thumb. That too, on his bowling hand - the right one. Oh dear, it is not the greatest of welcomes to the 'Gabba by Patrick. This is fast, fiery bowling. Dilruwan is getting his first two fingers taped on his right hand. He is trying to grip his bat and play but he is not ready yet. There is a long discussion going on.
Good length delivery outside off, Dilruwan looks to drive but gets beaten on this one.
Outside off, Perera lets it go.
DRINKS! The second one of the session. Will Sri Lanka survive till the last session? The way they are playing, doesn't look like it. The Aussie pacers have been superb in this session.
Angles this into the legs of Dickwella who tries flicking it but fails.
Pushed to the cover region by Perera. One run added to the total.
Defended off the back foot by Dilruwan.
Edge again and short of Marnus again. Encouraging stuff from Starc. Fuller in length on that fourth stump channel. Perera gets an outside edge towards the third slip.
Does not carry! Length on off, shapes away from Perera who gets an outside edge to Labuschagne at third slip. Marnus dives forward but the ball falls just short.
Full on middle and leg, Dickwella jams it out to mid on and gives his partner the strike.
Another peach to end. Length outside off, Perera hangs his bat out and stays inside his crease. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Beauty first up! Length outside off, Perera offers a shot but cannot get to the pitch of it.
The next man in is Dilruwan Perera.

OUT! Take a bow, Pat! Was making Silva play and miss for some time now and gets his outside edge eventually. On a good length outside off, Silva with no feet movement pokes at it and gets an outside edge. Paine at the back takes another one and Sri Lanka lose another one. That's the sixth wicket before the score reaches 100 and are in big trouble.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Bouncer! Silva ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.

RUN OUT CHANCE! Back of a length ball outside off, Dickwella just taps it with soft hands near the pitch and sets off for the run. Cummins gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but does not hit the stumps. Had he hit, Roshen was no way near the picture.
Full and on off, just pushed to the mid off region.
Better from Silva. Outside off, Silva lets it go.
Nice. Full and similar to the previous ball. Roshen is tentative as he hangs his bat out and the ball goes past his outside edge.
Full and on the off pole. Silva gets his bat down and defends it.
Fuller outside off, left alone.
Squares him up straight up. On a good length on middle, Silva gets an outside edge towards the off side.
Change of ends for Mitchell Starc.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Closer to the stumps, Dickwella taps it to the off side.
Picks the seam and leaves this one outside off.
Interesting leave. Length ball on off, comes back into Dickwella who thinks it will go away from him. Gets hit on his pads but height the issue here.
A bit short on middle and leg, Dickwella looks to upper cut it but fails to get any contact.
Length ball outside off, Dickwella leaves it alone.
Flighted delivery on middle, Dickwella sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, Niroshan leaves it alone.
Floated on off, Dickwella looks to defend but gets a bottom edge on this one.
Floated on off, Niroshan keeps it out.
BEATEN! Tossed up on off, Dickwella looks to defend but misses it.
FOUR! Good shot. Tossed up on leg, Dickwella sweeps it towards fine leg. Mitchell Starc was stationed at short fine leg. He puts in a dive but it goes through him for a boundary.
Outside off, Silva thinks of playing at it and then almost edges it back to the keeper.
Pushed to the cover region by Roshen.
Silva shoulders arms to let that one through.
On middle and leg, Dickwella tucks it away fine to the leg side for one.
BEAUTY! Length ball outside off. Moves away from Dickwella who jumps to poke at it but is beaten by pace and bounce.
Comes in from round the wicket and lands it around off, Dickwella hops a tad and bunts it down.
Full on off, Roshen drives it to covers.
Tossed up outside off, Roshen offers no shot and gets hit on the pads.
Floated on middle, Silva keeps it out.

DROPPED! Brilliant effort from Travis Head! Flighted delivery on middle, Dickwella plays a reverse sweep uppishly towards backward point where Travis Head moves to his left, then jumps and stretches his left hand and gets a hand to it. It was a very tough chance for him. The batsmen pick up a single.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen comes down the track and hits it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Roshen defends off the front foot.
BEATEN! Good shape on this one. Outside off, Niroshan looks to defend but misses it.
On off, Dickwella looks to defend but again gets an outside edge towards third slip.

Good length delivery on off, Dickwella looks to defend but gets an outside edge past third slip. It goes towards third man. The batsmen get two runs. Dickwella does not want to miss out on scoring opportunities.
Outside off, Dickwella leaves it alone.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Full on off, half volley from Cummins, Dickwella drives it through mid off past the fielder and the ball runs away to the fence. A boundary results.
Full on off, Dickwella plays it to point.
Pat Cummins replaces Jhye Richardson.
DRINKS! Good period of cricket for Australia. They have got two crucial wickets in the form of Kusal Mendis and Dananjaya de Silva.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen defends off the back foot.
Floated on off, Niroshan looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards third man. The fielder chases it and stops it comfortably. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Flighted delivery on middle, Dickwella defends off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen pushes it towards the leg side for a single.
Floated on middle, Roshen keeps it out.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen defends off the front foot.
Short of a length delivery, Niroshan looks to hook but misses it.
Outside off, Niroshan shoulders his arms to this one.
Good delivery. Outside off, Dickwella looks to play at it but misses it.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella defends off the front foot.
Outside off, Dickwella offers no shot.
Length delivery on off, Dickwella drives it through covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Floated on off, the batsman blocks it off his back foot.
Tossed up on off, Roshen defends off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Roshen keeps it out.
FOUR! Good shot. Floated on middle, Roshen plays a reverse sweep through point for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on off, Roshen defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen pushes it to short leg.
PEACH! Richardson is all class in this second spell. On a good length outside off, Dickwella feels for it but the ball goes past his outside of the bat.
Slightly wide off the off pole. Dickwella is happy to leave it alone.
Outside off, Dickwella lets it go.
Niroshan Dickwella is the new batsman in.

OUT! EDGE AND TAKEN! Jhye Richardson at it again. Third wicket for him and the fifth for Australia. What a start he is having. Fuller ball around off, draws Dhananjaya into the drive and gets his outside edge. Paine behind takes a simple catch. Wonderful stuff from Richardson. Pinned Dhananjaya back from the last three overs and now gets his wicket with a full ball. Sri Lanka in trouble as half their side is back in the hut.
Slightly fuller than the previous one. Once again blocked out with a straight bat.
Length ball on off, played back with a straight bat.
Loopy delivery on off, Roshen defends off the front foot.
Floated on off, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Short on off, Roshen cuts it towards point. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen comes down the track and blocks it.

Flighted delivery on off, Dananjaya comes down the track and gets an edge past first slip. It goes towards third man. Khawaja chases it and stops it just before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Flighted delivery on off, Dananjaya keeps it out.
Bowls a bouncer, Roshen does well to duck under it. Just one run off the over.
Third consecutive leave for Roshen Silva. Good length delivery outside off, Roshen lets it go again.
Outside off again, Roshen lets it go.
Outside off, Roshen offers no shot.
Short delivery, Dananjaya pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Dananjaya blocks it off his back foot.
Full on middle, Dananjaya drives it towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Roshen flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. First run after Tea. First run of the partnership also.
Tossed up on off, Roshen offers no bat on it.
Floated on off, the batsman blocks it off his back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Roshen comes down the track and blocks it.
Turns into middle, Roshen looks to cut but gets hit on the forearm.
Outside off, de Silva offers no shot. Maiden over from Richardson.
On middle, de Silva blocks it off his back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Dananjaya blocks it well.
Short outside off, de Silva cuts it to point.
On off, Dananjaya keeps it out.
Good length delivery on off, de Silva defends off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Silva flicks it to the leg side. Good over from Nathan Lyon.
Flighted delivery on off, Roshen defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Silva comes forward and looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
BEATEN! What a beauty of a delivery. Turns away from the batsman, Silva looks to defend but misses it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Silva defends off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Roshen comes down the track and pushes it to the bowler.
EDGE and falls short. Length ball on middle and leg, squares Dhananjaya who gets a leading edge towards the off side just short of the man at point.
Length this time on the stumps, de Silva blocks it out with a straight bat.
Oh boy! Lovely stuff from Jhye! Full and around off, Dhananjaya goes for the drive first up but cannot put bat to it.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new batsman.

OUT! TIMBER! Kusal Mendis departs! Whattaaaee ball from Jhye Richardson. Beauty of a delivery. It was pitched on middle, moved away a little after landing. Mendis looked to defend but get beaten as he just went to turn the bat face. The ball goes on to make an ugly sound as it crashes into top of middle and off. Sri Lanka lose their fourth wicket and Jhye strikes in the first over post the break.
Full on middle, Mendis drives it past the bowler and it hits the stumps at the bowler's end.
Length delivery on off, Mendis plays it to mid off.
We are back for the second session. Mendis and Silva will continue from where they left. Jhye Richardson will bowl the first over after the break. Three slips in place for him.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Jhye Richardson was very good in his debut. Got his first Test wicket and kept on troubling the Sri Lankan batsmen. Starc has got the odd ball to talk but not consistent enough while Lyon is getting good purchase already. At 58/3, Australia know they have the upper hand and will not want to let this slip. Join us back after the break.

A fighting session for both sides. Sri Lanka were patient at the start and did play well but couldn't resist their shots after a period of time. The two openers did struggle against the new ball but made sure they didn't throw their wickets away in that duration. Thirimanne and Chandimal then found their edges to the cordon while Karunaratne nicked one to Paine as time went by. Mendis is looking good and will hope Silva sticks with him for some time.
Silva gets behind this one and defends it out. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 1.
Quicker one on middle, turned away to the leg side.
Given air on off, bunted out. Good stuff from Lyon.
Fuller ball in line of the stumps, played back to Lyon.
Catch it is the call but that is off the pads. It balloons just ahead of the short leg fielder.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Mendis is forward to defend.
On a fuller length around off, Mendis punches it to mid off where Head does well to get behind it.
Down the leg sides, Mendis tries flicking it but misses.
Goes full now outside off, Kusal carves it to the man at cover-point.
Length outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.
SHOT! But Starc does well to get a hand to it. Fuller ball in line of the stumps, Mendis drives it along the turf but Starc gets low and stops the ball.
Length wide down the leg side though, no trouble at all for the batsman.
Almost chops it back! Shorter in length around off. Silva rocks back to cut but gets a bottom edge which misses the stumps.
On middle and leg, Mendis comes forward to block it but gets a soft edge to the off side and crosses over.
On the leg stump line, tucked away around the corner.
Around off, blocked to the off side.
On the leg stump, Mendis looks to leave it alone but it hits his pads outside leg.
A bit short on off, allows Mendis to go back and bunt it.
Bouncer on the last ball. Outside off, Silva does well to leave it alone.
Very full on the stump line outside off, Silva looks to stab it out but cannot put any bat to it.
Full and outside off, Silva gives it to the fielder at point.

Overpitched again from Starc. No swing. Mendis doesn't miss out on it. Leans ahead and drives it through covers. Lyon hares behind the ball and puts in a dive to save a run. Three runs added to the total.
Outside off, Mendis shoulders arms to let that one through.
Around off, driven to covers. Dot ball.
Roshen Silva walks out next to bat.

OUT! The Lyon roars! Turn and bounce for the GOAT and he gets his man! Brilliant! Spins this around off and moves away from Karunaratne. Draws him to play at it and then bounces sharply. Karunaratne can't do much than just feel for it. The ball brushes his gloves before settling into the mitts of Tim Paine. Good catch and a very important wicket for the Aussies. The southpaw has been in good form and could have tired the hosts.
Full and on off, driven to covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On the pads again, nicely nudged past the square leg region for one.
On the leg stump, Mendis leaves it alone and it touches his pads and flies past the short leg fielder.
Off spinner on off, Mendis blocks it out.
Landed outside off, let through.
A bouncer now, on middle, DK ducks.
Excellent follow-up from Starc. This is a toe-crusher, swinging in, from outside off, Dimuth just about digs it out.

FOUR! 50 UP FOR SRI LANKA. Starc searches for swing and goes too full. In fact it is so full that it does not land at all. Karunaratne makes full use of that full toss and works it through mid-wicket for a boundary. The stand moves to 22.
Landed outside off, shouldered arms to.
On a length around off, Karunaratne pushes it towards the off side, sets off for a single but then sends Mendis back who had almost come halfway.
Mitchell Starc returns for one final burst before Tea. 4-0-13-0 so far.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, Karunaratne misses his tuck and is hit on the pads.
Straight again, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and just around off, watchfully defended.
Down the leg side, a tad short, Mendis hops and works it down the leg side. Leg slip dives to his left but parries it wide. A run stolen.
Full and outside off, pushed wide of mid off for a single.
FOUR! CLOBBERED! A rare bad ball and Mendis pounces. Short and outside off, Kusal jumps, gets on top of the bounce and crashes a cut shot through point.
Full and wide outside off, KM initially looks to drive but then tries to bail out. Is late and gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, Kusal shoulders arms.
A wild bouncer, Mendis ducks.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery and blocks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
Short and outside off, Karunaratne punches it towards point where Pat Cummins gets across and slides but fumbles. The batsmen do not run though.
Around off, watchfully defended back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and works it wide of mid on for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
OFF THE MARK ON THE 15TH BALL! Mendis finally gets the scoreboard moving. Short and outside off, the right-hander stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and eases it behind point. Three runs taken.
Another one rips past the outside edge. KM is doing well to hang in there. This is good sharp bowling. On a length outside off, Mendis feels for it but the ball seams away and beats him.
A bouncer now, around off, Kusal ducks.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Short and outside off, punched to the off side.
Landed outside off, on a length, Mendis feels for it but misses.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off. Mitchell Starc takes a long time to return the ball at the bowler's end and the throw is wild. The batsmen return for the second.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nice lines, full and just outside off, Dimuth feels for the ball but is beaten.
Full and around off, Dimuth pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
TURN FIRST BALL. Boy, this is special. Lyon lands this on a length outside off and then gets it to spin a mile. Karunaratne is beaten miles.
Time for spin. The GOAT comes on to chew some grass in his favourite grassland. On comes Nathan Lyon.
Landed outside off, calmly let through.
Similar ball, but this time KM takes his bat away. The length was a bit too short on this occasion.
Good channel. Just outside off, landing on a length, hint of away seam movement, Kusal plays inside the line and misses.
Good running. Taps it with soft hands towards cover and takes a quick single.
Much better shot this time. Karunaratne gets to the pitch of the ball, eases into the drive and gets it wider of mid off than the previous time. Two more.
Full and outside off, driven with a loose bottom hand through mid off for a couple.
Full and around off, Mendis drives this straight down the ground. Travis Head gets across from a straightish mid on to his left, fumbles but the batsmen do not run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through again.
Outside off again, let through.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a good length outside off, Mendis pokes at it but misses.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Coming close to the wickets, landing on a tight line around off, Dimuth defends.
One more leave outside off.
Full and outside off, left alone.
A short ball now, Karunaratne hops and defends.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Kusal Mendis walks in next, at number 4, replacing his skipper.

OUT! First Test wicket for Jhye Richardson! He has probed so long and finally gets his reward. A long spell for him but it pays dividends. Length ball around off, forces Chandimal to poke at one more. He got an edge in the 3rd ball which didn't carry and also missed one in this over but not on this ball. Gets a healthy edge which flies to second slip. Joe Burns there dives to his left and takes a good low catch. Richardson pumps the air in delight and his teammates join him in celebration. The Sri Lankan skipper is out of here!
Chandimal has punched the ball off the backfoot.
Around off, and Chandimal defends it.
FOUR! Edge and away. Outside off, Chandimal plays at it again. Gets an edge but it goes through the slip cordon and into the third man fence. Slightly had that in control but not the best option.
Closer this and Chandimal gets figidity. Pokes at one which almost catches his outside edge.
Outside off, Chandimal opts to leave it alone.
Outside off, angled towards backward point. Dot ball. A wicket and just one from the over.
Serves this on a good length around off, Karunaratne gets behind it and blocks it.
Goes short to Karunaratne who ducks under another one.
Chandimal is off the mark. Full and on the leg side. Chandimal plays it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Dinesh Chandimal is in at no. 3.

OUT! First wicket of the game and it falls to Cummins. Full again and makes Thirimanne drive. Just like the last ball Lahiru goes after it. Nothing on the ball, it just straightens and takes the outside edge of the bat. Comes at a good height to Labuschagne who makes no mistake at third slip. Thirimanne never looked settled and now has to walk back. Not the best of return to Test cricket for him. Surprisingly, this opening stand of 26 is the joint best for Sri Lanka in Australia since 2007.
Nice from Pat Cummins. Full and makes Thirimanne drive who cannot put bat to ball.
Covers his stumps and sees this one out.
Played to the point region by DK.
On middle and leg, Karunaratne misses his flick and gets high on the pads. Jhye appeals but again height and down leg.
Bounces him again! Karunaratne is aware and ducks under it.
On middle and off this time. Karunaratne taps it in front of him.
Over the stumps on middle and leg, turned to square leg.
Gets behind this one and blocks it out.
Drags his length back, Thirimanne goes low for and lets it through.
Full on the pads, Thirimanne looks to drive this but gets another inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, played to the point region by Lahiru.
On the stumps this time, Thirimanne defends this from inside his crease.
Comes in from round the wicket and lands it full outside off, Thirimanne points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.

DRINKS! Jhye has been good with the ball while Starc has been spraying on the pitch. Must be some sort of plan but the Sri Lankans have done well to give them a scalp. Meanwhile, Pat Cummins comes into the attack.
Short ball on the body. Karunaratne gets low and evades it.
On a fuller length outside off, Karunaratne fails to put bat to ball trying to drive it.
Thirimanne has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! On the pads again, Thirimanne just clips it away towards fine leg. Starc from fine leg runs to his left and makes the save. At first it looked like a stop but he just had his hands on the ropes while throwing it back. Boundary.
On the pads, flicked away by Dimuth towards square leg for one.
Full and wide outside off, too far to make Karunaratne play at it.
Not this time. Full and wide, Thirimanne goes chasing after it. Plays it away from his body and to his surprise does not nick it back.
Starc not getting the ball to swing when he wants it. Bowls this a bit wide outside off, does not entice Thirimanne to drive.
Pitches this up further on the off pole. Thirimanne drives it back to the bowler.
BEAUTY! That's where Starc needs to be. Length ball, moves away just enough. Thirimanne looks to play at it and almost gets his outside edge back to the keeper.
Bouncer! Thirimanne ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Full on the pads, flicked away by Dimuth through square leg for a run.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
Karunaratne flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball outside off, Karunratne is not bothered to play at it.
Wide! Richardson looks to bounce Karunaratne but it is too high. Wide given by the umpire.
Karunaratne chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full and on off, Karunaratne looks to drive it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Karunratne lets the ball go outside his off stump.

NOT OUT! WHAT A REVIEW! Excellent! Looked like that would have gone on to clip the leg stump but Hawk Eye has the last say. Length ball on middle and leg. It goes on to hit the edge of Thirimanne's pads who misses his flick. Australia appeal and the umpire takes it up. After a discussion Sri Lanka take the review and replays show us that it would have gone to miss the leg stump.
Review time! Starc has got the first wicket but he has to wait. Thirimanne has taken it up.
No ball! Starc oversteps again! Only just. Full on the stumps! Lahiru blocks it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Perfect. Length ball outside off, goes straight. Thirimanne pokes at it but gets beaten.
On the pads, Karunaratne flicks it to the vacant square leg region for one.

WHAT A BOUNCER! Karunaratne is on the floor! Starc bangs it short into the body of Dimuth. Karunaratne sways away from it and loses his balance and ends up being on the floor. Excellent ball but a very good leave too.
Outside off, Thirimanne guides it through point and changes ends.
Ohh! Fuller ball tailing back into Karunaratne who somehow manages to get an inside edge onto his pads. A promising over from Jhye comes to an end.
Outside off again, left alone by Dimuth.
Too wide outside off to make Karunaratne play at it.
Overpitches this on the pads, Dimuth flicks it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Karunaratne has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Jhye asking the questions! Another appeal which dies down. On a good length on middle, swings back into Karunaratne who cannot get to the pitch of the ball. Gets hit on the pads and Australia appeal. Again height the issue. Wise call by the skipper not to take it up.
DK flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Karunaratne looks to drive but fails. Misses out on scoring there.
On the leg side, turned away on the on side.
Length again, not a lot of swing on offer, Karunaratne lets it be.
Fuller around off, played to mid on.
NO BALL! Starc oversteps and lands it on a good length on this occasion, Karunaratne does not play at it.

EDGE and just short of the man at third slip. Fuller ball outside off, Thirimanne goes fishing and gets an edge which falls short of Labuschagne at third slip. The ball goes past him and they change ends.
Karunaratne has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on leg, Lahiru has played it fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.

APPEAL! but turned down. Richardson almost gets his first wicket in Test cricket. On a good length on middle, Thirimanne leaves it alone but to his surprise the ball jags back in and hits him on the knee roll. Australia appeal but it was going over the stumps. Good option not to review it.
On the pads again, flicked way through square leg for a single.
Outside off, left alone.

Almost! Jhye serves his first ball on the leg side. Thirimanne plays it but the ball pops just wide of Harris at short leg. Can argue he could have been swifter but Lahiru survives. They cross as the ball rolls away on the on side.
Debutant, Jhye Richardson to share the new ball with Starc.
Lovely. Yorker on the leg stump. Lahiru does well to keep it out and jam it towards the on side. He picks up a run and will face the next over.
This one was closer to the stumps, Thirimanne defends it.
On a good length outside off, no real movement. Thirimanne leaves it alone.
This one is a bit full and outside off, Thirimanne put his bat out and guides it past the gully fielder for a couple of runs. So, both the openers are off the mark.
A different welcome for Thirimanne. Surprises him with a bouncer on the body. Lahiru tries ducking under it but gets hit on the shoulders and the ball goes towards Paine.

Comes in from round the wicket and Starc pitches it up in search of swing. Slightly overpitched on the pads, Dimuth flicks it away through mid-wicket and comes back for the third. Sri Lanka are up and running.

We are ready to begin! The Sri Lankan openers in Dimuth Karunaratne and Lahiru Thirimanne walk out to the middle. Mitchell Starc to bowl first with the pink ball. Three slips and a gully in place for him. All set to begin!
TOSS - Dinesh Chandimal wins the coin toss and will bat first.

The Gabba is all set to host its second day-night Test as Australia welcome Sri Lanka for a 2-match Test series. Hello and welcome to our coverage of this edition of the Australian summer. Sri Lanka fly down under and look to win their first Test series here. Australia on the other hand, will look to keep that record intact and show the critics what they are capable off. They didn't have the best of starts to their summer after India got the better of them. The Kangaroos have handed Jhye Richardson and Kurtis Patterson their caps and it will be interesting to see how they fare. A couple of other faces come in from their last Test series. Sri Lanka will be without Angelo Mathews and they will look to do better than what they did against the Kiwis. Stay with us for the toss.
